facets.description: _ensure_processes_alive (lines 253-259): isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) is always False for SpawnProcess, so a hung process is never killed before restart, which leads to duplicate flushing
join() (lines 346-347): the same isinstance check is always False for SpawnProcess, so terminate() never runs
join() (lines 338-341): the loop breaks once the deadline expires, so the remaining processes are never terminated
